item.title: KKR Completes Acquisition Of Cheongna Logistics Center In South Korea
item.description: KKR has completed the acquisition of Cheongna Logistics Center, a large-scale logistics facility in Incheon, South Korea, through a fund managed locally by its affiliated Korean asset manager, Kreate Asset Management (Kreate). KKR said the deal represents the largest single-asset logistics transaction in South Korea to date, underscoring sustained institutional demand for modern, high-specification warehouse space tied to the country’s e-commerce-led logistics growth.
